programme.desc: Let the party begin. Huge feel good anthems & sing-out-loud classics - all from the decade of dance!

programme.title: Big Name Nicknames! Top 25

programme.title: Better Known for Other Things!
programme.desc: Actors that can sing? Who'd have thought! Abz runs down the great and the not so great of 90s singing comedians, soapstars, TV presenters & Hollywood A-listers!

programme.title: Sold & Downloaded: The UK's Best!
programme.desc: From physical sales in the 90s to digital downloads in the 00s! Every track was a smash hit and every video a UK chart number one!

programme.title: Spice Girls: Greatest Hits
programme.desc: All the 90s hits from Wannabe to Goodbye - in the order you enjoyed them first time around! For 45 minutes - Spice Up Your Life one more time!

programme.title: Here Come The Girls!
programme.desc: From global chart queens of the 90s to forgotten reality stars of the 00s! Expect anthems, iconic leading ladies and 100% girl power that will Spice Up Your Life!

programme.title: Top Singalongs! 1990-1999
programme.desc: In order - 4 hours of the biggest karaoke anthems of the 90s - from EMF & Happy Mondays to Ricky Martin & 5ive. Prepare to sing out loud!

programme.title: Just 1 More! 30 Reasons To Stay Up
programme.desc: The party is not over just yet! ...maybe just one more anthem or sing-a-long before we call it a night eh?

programme.title: Back To The Bangers!
programme.desc: Turn it up loud! As we return to the biggest bangers & classic floorfillers that make every 90s & 00s party epic!

programme.title: Spinning Around! The 00s Party
programme.desc: Dust off your flip phones and get ready to dance the day away with the ultimate collection of hits that'll transport you back to those unforgettable millenium parties!

programme.title: The 1992 Video Hall of Fame

programme.title: 1993's Best Sellers
programme.desc: A complete rundown of the 30 biggest selling singles in the UK for 1993 including two chart toppers from Take That!

programme.title: 1993 Unleashed!
programme.desc: The standout chart music that defined the decade - from Britpop, Boybands & R&B to the birth of electronic dance beats!

programme.title: The NOW Yearbook 1994

programme.title: Forgotten Favourites!
programme.desc: Pop hits & hidden gems that you have definitely heard but probably forgotten you loved! Including Westlife, Britney, Backstreet Boys, The Spice Girls & loads more!

programme.desc: Pop hits & hidden gems that you have definitely heard but probably forgotten you loved! Including Westlife, Britney, Backstreet Boys, The Spice Girls & loads more!

programme.title: Here Come The Girls!
programme.desc: From global chart queens of the 90s to forgotten reality stars of the 00s! Expect anthems, iconic leading ladies and 100% girl power that will Spice Up Your Life!

programme.title: All Killer: 00s Emo Anthems!
programme.desc: "An hour of the greatest emo tracks the noughties had to offer featuring Linkin Park, Fall Out Boy,

programme.title: Jenny Powell's Air Guitar Anthems!

programme.desc: A definitive five-hour marathon of '80s guitar anthems! From Queen and AC/DC in 1980 to Def Leppard and Guns N' Roses in 1989 - 60 rock classics are here, in order!

programme.desc: Monster party rock anthems for your Halloween! From Queen, Kiss and Aerosmith to Blur, Paramore and The White Stripes.

programme.title: The Rocky Horror Picture Show: Strange Journey
programme.desc: A London theatre play evolves into a cult sensation, celebrating individuality through iconic songs and a legendary performance from the late Tim Curry. 2025.

programme.title: Jonathan Demme: The Directors
programme.desc: Jonathan Demme: The man responsible for the crime thriller The Silence of the Lambs, take a look at the life and career of Jonathan Demme. (S7, ep 5)

programme.title: Up from the Streets: New...
programme.desc: ...Orleans - the City of Music. New. Hosted by Terence Blanchard, this film explores how music and culture came together in New Orleans to create a vibrant and influential identity.

programme.title: The Warhol Effect
programme.desc: Film lifting the lid on the fascinating last decade of Andy Warhol's life and the legacy he left for future artists, through never-before-seen footage and interviews with insiders.

programme.title: Stories From The National Portrait Gallery
programme.desc: Kate Bryan explores 20th-century portraiture, examining depictions of war poets and Queen Elizabeth II. Jim Moir drops in to discuss his favourite work. (S1, ep 3)

programme.title: The Sixties
programme.desc: The War in Vietnam: A look at the complexities that led to America's involvement in the Vietnam War and how it changed America in ways that reverberate even today. (S1, ep 4)

programme.title: Andrea Bocelli: A Night In Tuscany
programme.desc: Recorded in Pisa's Piazza dei Cavalieri in 1997, this unforgettable concert captures an evening of world-class music in the heart of Tuscany.

programme.title: Artist Of The Year: Masterclass
programme.desc: Narrative in Portraiture: Semi-Finalist Jude Wainwright demonstrates how she creates symbolic portraits using imagery from her dreams. (S1, ep 39)

programme.title: Artist Of The Year: Masterclass
programme.desc: Improvising with Watercolour: Artist Charles Williams demonstrates how he creates compositions based on his childhood memories and artistic influences. (S1, ep 40)

programme.title: Tales Of The Unexpected
programme.desc: Galloping Foxley: John Mills stars in this twisted tale. A man starts to suffer when he becomes haunted by the memory of the brutal treatment he received in his childhood. (S2, ep 2)

programme.title: Tales Of The Unexpected
programme.desc: Georgy Porgy: Joan Collins stars in a twisted tale. George has problems with female attention, but when a beautiful woman joins his congregation things are set to change. (S2, ep 3)

programme.title: Alfred Hitchcock Presents
programme.desc: Sylvia: A man fears his mentally unstable daughter has bought a gun to kill herself, but he might have it all wrong. (S3, ep 16)

programme.title: Alfred Hitchcock Presents
programme.desc: The Motive: A man, who has a theory that murders committed without motive are rarely solved, is coaxed by his friend into killing someone. (S3, ep 17)

programme.title: Discovering: Sally Field
programme.desc: Sally Field: A look at the life and career of the the Academy Award-winning actor whose glittering portfolio includes Norma Rae, Places in the Heart and Mrs Doubtfire. (S12, ep 13)

programme.title: Discovering: Crosby, Stills, Nash & Young
programme.desc: A look at the late David Crosby's folk-rock super group - Crosby, Stills, Nash & Young - famed for their vocal harmonies and fiery interpersonal relationships. (S5, ep 19)

programme.title: Discovering: Neil Young
programme.desc: From Crazy Horse to Crosby, Stills, Nash & Young, Neil Young was a driving force behind some of the biggest groups of the 60s before finding huge success on his own. (S5, ep 20)

programme.title: Tales Of The Unexpected
programme.desc: Royal Jelly: Herbert Wise stars in this twisted tale. Mabel's baby is sick and her bee-obsessed husband thinks he has found a remedy. Will he get the baby buzzing back to health? (S2, ep 4)

programme.title: Tales Of The Unexpected
programme.desc: Poison: Andrew Ray stars in Roald Dahl's twisted tale. A poisonous snake keeps a teacher prisoner in India. How can he escape from its evil glare? (S2, ep 5)

programme.title: Alfred Hitchcock Presents
programme.desc: Miss Bracegirdle Does Her Girdle: Millicent Bracegirdle, an elderly woman, decides to go to Paris. But her trip goes awry when she ends up trapped with a murderer. (S3, ep 18)

programme.title: Alfred Hitchcock Presents
programme.desc: The Equalizer: A man challenges a much larger gentleman to a duel with weapons after his lustful actions caused his wife to leave him. (S3, ep 19)

programme.title: The Sixties
programme.desc: A Long March to Freedom: An in-depth look into Martin Luther King Jr and his courageous efforts to lead the civil rights movement. (S1, ep 5)

programme.title: Discovering: Tom Hanks
programme.desc: A glimpse into the life and career of the Academy Award-winning Hollywood star, known for his excellent work in films such as Forrest Gump and The Green Mile. (S13, ep 1)

programme.title: Landscape Artist Of The Year
programme.desc: Hosts Joan Bakewell and Frank Skinner launch a nationwide search for the Landscape Artist of the Year 2017 as contestants paint iconic locations across the country. (1 of 9)

programme.title: Tales Of The Unexpected
programme.desc: The Hitch-Hiker: Rod Taylor stars in Roald Dahl's twisted tale. When a driver picks up a hitch-hiker in his car, his journey turns into a thrilling ride. (S2, ep 6)

programme.title: Tales Of The Unexpected
programme.desc: Genesis and Catastrophe: A Roald Dahl story with a twist. A pregnant lady is worried that she may miscarry for the fourth time. Can her doctor reassure her? (S2, ep 7)

programme.title: The Alfred Hitchcock Hour
programme.desc: The Thirty-First of February: The death of a man's wife is ruled an accident, but strange incidents at the widower's place of work raise new questions. (S1, ep 15)

programme.title: Guy Garvey: From The Vaults
programme.desc: Britpop: Elbow frontman Guy Garvey lifts the lid on two decades of TV gold. Here, he takes you through music genre and culture movement Britpop. (5 of 5)

programme.title: Hammer: Heroes, Legends and Monsters
programme.desc: From a back office in London to its iconic status within the horror film genre, celebrate Hammer Horror's 90th anniversary. With contributions from Tim Burton.

programme.title: Dickens: Phantoms And Fiction
programme.desc: Captivating documentary exploring the haunting world of Charles Dickens' supernatural tales through actor readings, archive footage and immersive visuals.

programme.title: David Gilmour: Live At The Circus Maximus, Rome
programme.desc: New. Captured at Rome's historic Circus Maximus in 2024, David Gilmour performs songs from his latest album alongside favourites from the Pink Floyd.

programme.title: Pink Floyd: The Story Of Wish You Were Here
programme.desc: Roger Waters, David Gilmour, Nick Mason, Richard Wright and others tell the story of the creative process of the album 'Wish You Were Here', released in September 1975.

programme.title: Stories From The National Gallery

programme.desc: Death in Slow Motion. 1966. Stars Adam West, Frank Gorshin & Sherry Jackson. Disguised as Charlie Chaplin, The Riddler strikes the box office of a silent film showing.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: The Riddler's False Notion. 1966. Stars Adam West, Frank Gorshin & Sherry Jackson. The Riddler escapes, but Batman captures a hostage of his own, the Riddler's moll, Pauline.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes
programme.desc: The Case of the Tyrant's Daughter. 1955. Stars Ronald Howard, Archie Duncan & Basil Dignam. Sherlock is called to investigate after a chemist is accused of murdering his fiancé's stepfather.

programme.title: Doublecross
programme.desc: 1955. Drama. Director Anthony Squire. Stars Donald Houston, Fay Compton, William Hartnell. A Cornish poacher clashes with dangerous international spies.

programme.title: The Secret Six
programme.desc: 1931. Crime Drama. Directed by George W. Hill. Stars Wallace Beery, Lewis Stone & Jean Harlow. A group of vigilantes come together to bring down a gang of bootleggers.

programme.title: Man From Tangier
programme.desc: 1957. Drama. Director: Lance Comfort. Stars Robert Hutton, Lisa Gastoni & Martin Benson. Chuck Collins finds himself involved in a passport and forgery racket, just through taking the wrong coat!

programme.title: Appointment with Venus
programme.desc: 1951. War. Director: Ralph Thomas. Stars: David Niven, Glynis Johns & George Coulouris. During WWII, a British Major is tasked with rescuing a pedigree cow from a German-occupied Channel Island.

programme.title: Four Star Playhouse: The Stacked Deck
programme.desc: 1956. Stars Dick Powell, Shirley Patterson & Regis Toomey. Willie Dante is threatened by blackmailer Gus Anderson who intends to use his casino to launder his victim's money.

programme.title: Spotlight on the Stars Margaret Lockwood
programme.desc: 1948. Let's turn back the spotlight with Margaret Lockwood as she presents some of the pictures and personalities who are up to be voted for in the 1948 National Film Awards.

programme.title: The Duchess of Duke Street
programme.desc: No Letters, No Lawyers. 1976. Stars Gemma Jones, James Laurenson & Thorley Walters. A journalist poses as a porter to gather information on Louisa that may ruin her personal & professional life.

programme.title: Whistle Down the Wind
programme.desc: 1961. Drama. Directed by Bryan Forbes and starring Bernard Lee, Alan Bates and Hayley Mills. Three young children encounter a murderer on the run.

programme.title: Look At Life Turning Blades
programme.desc: 1962. A look at the importance of the helicopter and its uses, both civil and military but also its failure to become a passenger carrier.

programme.title: Julius Hagen Season
programme.desc: Noel presents an informative session about the 1935 film A Fire Has Been Arranged, directed by Leslie Hiscott, a member of the Twickenham Studios board and filmed during a heatwave in 1934.

programme.title: A Fire Has Been Arranged
programme.desc: 1935. Directed Leslie S. Hiscott. Stars Bud Flanagan, Chesney Allen & Rob Wilton. Two robbers hide their loot before spending 10 years in jail, but upon release they realise things have changed.

programme.title: Julius Hagen Season
programme.desc: Tune in to find out which brilliant Julius Hagen film will be shown next week.

programme.title: Weir's Way
programme.desc: Glen Affric. 1979. Tom Weir visits Glen Affric in the central Highlands of Scotland to discover how such an expanse of remote land is managed and learns about how modern society affects the area.

programme.title: The Brothers
programme.desc: The Race. 1974. Stars Jennifer Wilson, Richard Easton, John Rolfe. The board is divided about sponsorship of David's race. Meanwhile, Martin questions Brian about Jennifer's relationship with Ted.

programme.title: Mark Saber
programme.desc: Fast Cars and Fast Girls. 1957. Stars Donald Gray, Neil McCallum & John Loder. Colonel March asks Mark Saber for help when his wheelchair bound friend, Major Beanie, goes missing.

programme.title: The Wheeltappers and Shunters Social Club
programme.desc: Episode 23. 1975. Tony Christie sings 'Amarillo' and 'Old Man River'. Francis Yip sings 'Make My Life a Bit Brighter'. Terri Rogers, Alan Randall and Eddie Flanagan also star.

programme.title: The Undertaker
programme.desc: 2023. Thriller. Director: Michael Wright. Stars Paul McGann, Tara Fitzgerald & Murray Melvin. An undertaker makes the wrong call at a moral crossroad and has to dispose of a gangster's victims.

programme.title: Bad Blood
programme.desc: 1981. Drama. Directed by Mike Newell. Starring Jack Thompson. Set in WW2, a New Zealand farmer who refuses to hand in his firearms and the siege that follows. Based on a true story.
